candidate_senses.definition: the linear extent in space from one end to the other; the longest dimension of something that is fixed in place
examples: the length of the table was 5 feet

candidate_senses.definition: continuance in time
examples: the ceremony was of short duration
he complained about the length of time required

candidate_senses.definition: the property of being the extent of something from beginning to end
examples: the editor limited the length of my article to 500 words

candidate_senses.definition: size of the gap between two places
examples: the distance from New York to Chicago
he determined the length of the shortest line segment joining the two points

candidate_senses.definition: a section of something that is long and narrow
examples: a length of timber
a length of tubing
